user.title: Ecovacs account
user.description: Sign in with the account the robot is registered to. The country must match the one the Ecovacs app uses, because it selects which regional servers the robot is reachable on.

data_description.country: The country your Ecovacs account was created in.

verification.title: Verify this device
verification.description: Ecovacs has emailed a one-time code to verify this Home Assistant installation. Enter it below. This is asked once per installation, not once per sign-in.

robot.title: Choose a robot
robot.description: One entry per robot, so that removing one leaves the others untouched.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Ecovacs cloud rejected the stored credentials for {username}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ecovacs cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The Ecovacs cloud rejected that email address or password.
error.invalid_verification_code: That code was not accepted. It may have expired; a new one can be requested by starting again.
error.no_robots: Signed in, but the account lists no robots.

abort.already_configured: That robot already has an entry.

command_failed.message: The robot did not carry out {command}. It may be offline, or it may not support that command.

no_rooms.message: This robot has not reported any rooms. It needs a saved map, built by a full cleaning run, before it can be sent to one.

unknown_rooms.message: No room called {rooms} on the robot's map. It knows: {known}.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Send the robot to clean one or more named rooms of its saved map, in a single job.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Room names as they appear on the robot's map, or their numeric ids.

cleanings.name: Passes
cleanings.description: How many times to go over each room. The robot decides what it will accept.
